Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

FlashInfer TRT-LLM MoE allocates temporary scratch on each invocation. This causes memory usage spike during autotuning. Reusing persistent buffers per each maximum tuning token can significantly reduce the memory usage.

## Modifications

- Add `get_trtllm_moe_workspace()` with cached sizing and separate buffers per device and CUDA stream.
- Integrate workspace reuse into BF16, FP8, MXFP4, NVFP4, and MXINT4 paths.
- Preserve per-call allocation fallbacks for unsupported FlashInfer versions, deferred finalize, and oversized batches.
- Add workspace related unit tests.

## Accuracy Tests

- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+"""Caller-owned scratch for sequential FlashInfer TRT-LLM MoE launches."""
+
+import logging
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import (
+    get_buffer,
+    get_context,
+    get_parallel,
+    get_schedule,
+    max_prefill_buffer_tokens,
+)
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class TrtllmMoeWorkspace:
+    """Cache sizing queries and share scratch across layers on the same stream.
+
+    Size queries and buffer allocation may run during capture. Keep every buffer
+    alive without resizing or replacing it, so captured graphs retain stable
+    addresses.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, max_rows: int):
+        self.max_rows = max_rows
+        self.sizes = {}
+        self.buffers = {}
+
+    def get(self, quant_mode: str, kwargs: dict):
+        x = kwargs["hidden_states"]
+        if (
+            not kwargs.get("do_finalize", True)
+            or x.shape[0] == 0
+            or max(x.shape[0], kwargs.get("tune_max_num_tokens", 8192)) > self.max_rows
+        ):
+            return None
+
+        from flashinfer import fused_moe
+
+        sizer = getattr(fused_moe, "trtllm_fused_moe_workspace_size", None)
+        if sizer is None:
+            return None
+
+        options = {
+            "quant_mode": quant_mode,
+            "local_num_experts": kwargs["local_num_experts"],
+            "num_fused_shared_experts": kwargs.get("num_fused_shared_experts") or 0,
+            "use_shuffled_weight": kwargs.get("use_shuffled_weight", True),
+            "weight_layout": kwargs.get("weight_layout"),
+            "use_routing_scales_on_input": kwargs.get(
+                "use_routing_scales_on_input", False
+            ),
+            "use_per_token_scale": kwargs.get("per_token_scale") is not None,
+            "valid_hidden_size": kwargs.get("valid_hidden_size"),
+            "valid_intermediate_size": kwargs.get("valid_intermediate_size"),
+            "device": x.device,
+        }
+        if kwargs.get("activation_type") is not None:
+            options["activation_type"] = int(kwargs["activation_type"])
+        problem = (
+            self.max_rows,
+            x.shape[1] * (2 if quant_mode == "nvfp4" else 1),
+            kwargs["intermediate_size"],
+            kwargs["num_experts"],
+            kwargs["top_k"],
+        )
+        size_key = (problem, tuple(options.items()))
+        if size_key not in self.sizes:
+            try:
+                self.sizes[size_key] = int(sizer(*problem, **options))
+            except (RuntimeError, ValueError) as exc:
+                logger.warning("TRT-LLM MoE workspace sizing failed: %s", exc)
+                self.sizes[size_key] = 0
+        nbytes = self.sizes[size_key]
+        if nbytes <= 0:
+            return None
+        stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(x.device).cuda_stream
+        buffer_key = (x.device, stream, nbytes)
+        if buffer_key not in self.buffers:
+            self.buffers[buffer_key] = torch.empty(
+                nbytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device=x.device
+            )
+            logger.info(
+                "Reserved %.2f GiB TRT-LLM MoE workspace for up to %d tokens",
+                nbytes / (1 << 30),
+                self.max_rows,
+            )
+        return self.buffers[buffer_key]
+
+
+def _make_workspace():
+    schedule = get_schedule()
+    rows = (
+        max(
+            max_prefill_buffer_tokens() or schedule.max_prefill_tokens,
+            schedule.max_running_requests or 0,
+        )
+        * get_parallel().attn_dp_size
+    )
+    # Include the power-of-two autotuning bucket, even for a non-power-of-two
+    # prefill chunk. Larger unchunked/speculative batches use per-call scratch.
+    return TrtllmMoeWorkspace(1 << (max(1, rows) - 1).bit_length())
+
+
+def get_trtllm_moe_workspace(quant_mode: str, **kwargs) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    """Return reusable scratch, or None when per-call allocation is needed.
+
+    Callers should omit workspace_buffer when this returns None, preserving
+    compatibility with FlashInfer versions without caller-owned scratch.
+    """
+    if not kwargs.get(
+        "do_finalize", True
+    ) or not get_context().is_config_namespace_published("schedule"):
+        return None
+    workspace = get_buffer("trtllm_moe_workspace", _make_workspace)
+    return workspace.get(quant_mode, kwargs)

+"""Compare caller-owned and per-call TRT-LLM MoE scratch on Blackwell."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.trtllm_moe_workspace import get_trtllm_moe_workspace
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_resources, publish, reset_context
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=30, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+
+class TestTrtllmMoeWorkspaceParity(CustomTestCase):
+    @unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "requires CUDA")
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_small_first_and_cuda_graph(self):
+        import flashinfer.fused_moe as fi
+        from flashinfer.fused_moe.core import ActivationType
+
+        if torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] != 10:
+            self.skipTest("requires Blackwell")
+        if not hasattr(fi, "trtllm_fused_moe_workspace_size"):
+            self.skipTest("requires FlashInfer caller-owned MoE workspace API")
+        reset_context()
+        self.addCleanup(reset_context)
+        publish(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy", chunked_prefill_size=32), role="test")
+        torch.manual_seed(42)
+        for activation in (ActivationType.Swiglu, ActivationType.Relu2):
+            with self.subTest(activation=activation):
+                self._check_activation(fi, activation)
+
+    def _check_activation(self, fi, activation):
+        from flashinfer.fused_moe.core import ActivationType
+
+        fc1 = 512 if activation == ActivationType.Swiglu else 256
+        # Random values already in the kernel's BlockMajorK layout.
+        w1 = torch.randn(8, 2, fc1, 128, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 10
+        w2 = torch.randn(8, 2, 256, 128, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 10
+        x = torch.randn(32, 256, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 10
+        ids = torch.tensor([0, 1], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).repeat(32, 1)
+        weights = torch.full((32, 2), 0.5, device="cuda")
+        buffers = []
+
+        def checked_accuracy(**kwargs):
+            buffers.append(kwargs.get("workspace_buffer"))
+            actual = fi.trtllm_bf16_routed_moe(**kwargs)
+            reference = fi.trtllm_bf16_routed_moe(
+                **{**kwargs, "workspace_buffer": None}
+            )
+            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, reference)
+            return actual
+
+        def kwargs(rows):
+            return {
+                "hidden_states": x[:rows],
+                "topk_ids": (ids[:rows], weights[:rows]),
+                "gemm1_weights": w1,
+                "gemm2_weights": w2,
+                "num_experts": 8,
+                "local_num_experts": 8,
+                "local_expert_offset": 0,
+                "top_k": 2,
+                "n_group": None,
+                "topk_group": None,
+                "intermediate_size": 256,
+                "activation_type": activation.value,
+                "tune_max_num_tokens": 32,
+            }
+
+        for rows in (1, 32, 16):
+            checked_accuracy(
+                **kwargs(rows),
+                workspace_buffer=get_trtllm_moe_workspace("bf16", **kwargs(rows)),
+            )
+        self.assertIsNotNone(buffers[0])
+        # All workspace buffers are the same due to the same tune_max_num_tokens
+        self.assertTrue(all(buffer is buffers[0] for buffer in buffers))
+        # Warm the FlashInfer kernels on the eager stream, then discard only
+        # cached sizes to exercise sizing and allocation during capture.
+        stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        workspace = get_resources().buffers["trtllm_moe_workspace"]
+        workspace.sizes.clear()
+        before = len(workspace.buffers)
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=stream):
+            capture_workspace = get_trtllm_moe_workspace("bf16", **kwargs(32))
+            captured = fi.trtllm_bf16_routed_moe(
+                **kwargs(32),
+                workspace_buffer=capture_workspace,
+            )
+        self.assertIsNotNone(capture_workspace)
+        self.assertEqual(len(workspace.sizes), 1)
+        self.assertNotEqual(capture_workspace.data_ptr(), buffers[0].data_ptr())
+        x.mul_(0.5)
+        graph.replay()
+        expected = fi.trtllm_bf16_routed_moe(**kwargs(32))
+        torch.testing.assert_close(captured, expected)
+        self.assertEqual(len(workspace.buffers), before + 1)
+

+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
